name: Strut Tower & Chassis Braces
description: Bolt-on braces tying the front strut towers together and the rear shock towers together. (Cradle braces are listed with the cradles under suspension.front-cradle / suspension.rear-cradle; the tunnel brace is under chassis.floor-and-tunnel.)

components.name: Front strut tower brace
components.description: Cross-car bar bolted to the three strut top-mount bolt locations on each tower, reducing tower-to-tower flex and keeping front camber consistent under load. On the Gen 6 V8 cars the bar must clear the LT1 intake or LT4 supercharger lid. If a cage with forward tubes to the towers is fitted, the brace becomes largely redundant.
components.location: Across the engine bay at the tower tops, x approx 0.05, y approx 0.87, z from +0.55 to -0.55.

factory.name: Not fitted on most Gen 6 trims
factory.notes: Verify for your car; several trims have no factory bar.

raceOptions.name: BMR STB018 front strut tower brace (V8 only)
raceOptions.notes: Replaces all 6 strut tower bolts with supplied longer bolts and spacers, torque 16 ft-lb. Does not fit V6/2.0T. If using BMR WAK360/361 camber plates use the longer plate bolts supplied for the brace.

raceOptions.name: Cage forward tubes to towers (if class allows)

hardware.item: Strut tower brace bolt (replaces strut upper mounting bolt)
hardware.spec: M8 long flange bolt + spacer (supplied with brace), 13 mm hex
hardware.torqueSequence: Wheels on ground or strut supported so it cannot drop; snug all, then torque
hardware.notes: Discard the factory bolts per BMR; same torque as GM strut upper mounting bolt.

installNotes: Install with the car on its wheels (or the knuckles supported) so the struts do not drop out of the locator holes when bolts are removed.
Install after camber plates and after the engine (supercharger/intake clearance).
inspection: Re-torque bolts after first session; check for contact with intake/supercharger under engine rock.

sources.title: BMR 6th gen Camaro product line overview

modelRef.features: Tube brace with 3-stud end plates on the strut tops, arched over the engine

components.name: Rear shock tower brace / trunk cross-brace
components.description: Cross-car brace between the rear shock towers (trunk side) or cage rear down-tube cross bar. Stiffens the rear damper mounts, which matters more if the car is converted to rear coilovers that put spring load into the shock pad.
components.location: Trunk, x approx 2.75, y approx 0.72, z +/-0.58.

raceOptions.name: Fabricated tubular bar or cage cross tube

hardware.notes: Generic for a fabricated bolt-on brace; do not reuse the factory shock nuts as brace fasteners unless the brace was designed for them (factory shock nuts are 43 N·m).

installNotes: Fit after rear shocks/coilovers so top mount clearance can be checked.

modelRef.features: Fabricated tube between the rear shock tower tops
